title: Copilot Studio: conversational set-up of connector connections with in-chat sign-in
summary: Hold: the statement that Learn does not describe unattended handling overlooks Microsoft's documented failure of autonomous runs when maker-provided credentials are disabled. The roadmap facts, connector-policy controls and stated licensing routes are supported; the connection experience itself remains cautiously distinguished from the roadmap feature.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions, final sentence
claims.claim: Learn does not describe what happens without a user present to respond, leaving autonomous handling unconfirmed.
claims.quote: When maker-provided credentials are prevented from being used, agents require real-time user interaction because each tool call must be authenticated with a live user sign-in.
claims.fix: Remove the sentence beginning 'Learn does not describe what happens when no user is present'. Learn documents a relevant case at https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-copilot-studio/configure-no-maker-authentication: when maker-provided credentials are disabled, scheduled, autonomous and background agents fail due to missing credentials and require an active user. Removing the sentence avoids implying that this conditional limitation is undocumented, without asserting that the roadmap feature maps to that setting.
